name: Compact audit trail on stop
oneLine: Appends a one-line JSON record to a local audit log every time Claude finishes a turn.
description: Fires on Stop and appends {timestamp, session_id, cwd} to .claude/stop-audit.jsonl. Enough to reconstruct when sessions happened and where, without parsing the transcript (which lags during the Stop event - do not read it for the final answer). Redact-minded: no prompts, no tool inputs, nothing sensitive.
scriptBody:
#!/bin/bash
# compact-audit-trail: one JSON line per completed turn.
set -u
input=$(cat)
session=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"')
cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // "unknown"')
log="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/stop-audit.jsonl"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$log")"
jq -n --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg s "$session" --arg c "$cwd"   '{ts: $ts, session: $s, cwd: $c}' >> "$log"
exit 0
installSteps: Save the script to .claude/hooks/compact-audit-trail.sh and chmod +x it.
Add .claude/stop-audit.jsonl to .gitignore if you do not want it committed.
testSteps: Positive: run one turn, then check .claude/stop-audit.jsonl has a new JSON line.
Negative: the file should contain no prompts or tool inputs - verify the line shape.
verifiedAgainst: Claude Code hooks reference, event/matcher schema checked 2026-09-10
seoTitle: Compact audit trail on stop - Claude Code hook
seoDescription: A Stop hook that appends a minimal JSON audit record per turn.
